correctness.rationale: The blowup anticanonical monomials are exactly the eight lattice points E. Leading-monomial divisibility gives the finite Cartesian footprint lower bound, and the falling-factorial polynomials give equality for each exponent subset over all prime powers with q>=5. Exhaustive exact coefficient-certificate comparison of all 255 exponent subsets yields the full generalized-weight vector. A quadratic interpolation lemma forces four points on a line for rank at most three of four points and forces four of five onto a line for rank at most four of five points; adding x^2y rules out nonaxis collinear four-sets as optimizers. On coordinate lines V restricts to degree<=2; after division by the line equation, the five-dimensional residual space contains 1,x,y so two off-line points have independent evaluations. Thus every optimal rank-3 flat is a full coordinate fibre, and every optimal rank-4 flat is one such fibre plus one off-fibre point. Their uniqueness gives N5=2(q-1) and N4=2(q-1)^2(q-2), including q=5 boundary. Separate exact finite-field linear-algebra checks fully enumerate rank-3 and rank-4 flats over F5,F7 and match.

originality.rationale: The claim is not a general footprint theorem nor only a weight hierarchy. It classifies every attaining four- and five-dimensional subcode for this eight-monomial degree-seven del Pezzo torus and gives the two-ruling exact counts over all prime powers. The closest inspected cubic-scroll five-monomial result has one ruling and different subcode ranks; the degree-six hexagon and quartic-scroll work use different exponent supports and do not entail these counts. Whole-surface del Pezzo weight formulas and complete Cartesian-code theorems do not identify or count these punctured, non-complete Ferrers-space equality cases. Targeted published-finding corpus and mathematical literature comparisons found no equal or logically dominating classification; residual unindexed priority is acknowledged.
residual_risks: Unindexed specialized code or linear-section literature might contain the precise all-minimizer statement; historical priority is provisional.
The all-field equality classification is self-contained but has not been independently reviewed.

value.rationale: On a distinguished smooth toric del Pezzo surface the anticanonical embedding offers a natural pair of rational ruling families. Determining which linear sections have the maximum finite-field torus intersections and counting all such sections clarifies the geometry of generalized support minimizers. The complete ranks four and five equality-case classification holds uniformly for every prime power q>=5, and the factor-of-two split between two ruling families is a structural, motivated arithmetic refinement not determined by a basic footprint bound or by the known one-ruling cubic-scroll result.
